verdict.rationale: ClickHouse publishes an official MCP server for connecting AI assistants and documents MCP client setup. Its official CLI can execute queries and install agent skills into coding agents, so an agent can run SQL against ClickHouse through first-party tooling. Nothing in the evidence shows the tools are scoped, or that read-only queries are separated from destructive schema or write operations, and that separation is the safety half of the story. Missing for 10: documented separation of read-only vs destructive tools, permission scoping or confirmation for schema-changing operations, and hands-on corroboration of safe agent delegation.
